class.name: gz_transport_hardware_interface/GzTransportSystemInterface
class.description: GzTransport hardware interface. Publishes joint commands to the Gazebo physics engine via gz-transport and reads joint state feedback back, completely bypassing ROS 2 DDS. Enables multi-domain operations where the controller_manager runs natively on the robot's ROS_DOMAIN_ID while Gazebo runs on a separate domain.
